name: alert
purpose: Inline feedback banner that communicates status, alerts, or progress. Presents a severity-colored surface with a leading icon and a single line of message copy that may carry inline links, plus an optional secondary action button.
useWhen: A status, warning or error that belongs to a page, section or form and should stay visible in context.
A notice with an inline link, or with one follow-up action (`actionLabel` or the `action` slot).
avoidWhen: A transient confirmation of an action → use `toast`.
Validation feedback under one form field → use `helper-text`.
An admonition inside documentation prose → use `doc-callout`.
A promotional band between page sections → use `banner`.
related: toast` — overlay stack raised imperatively, auto-dismissing and not anchored to content.
helper-text` — field-level guidance and errors below an input.
doc-callout` — docs admonition rendered on the `Alert` surface.
empty-state` — a full zero-data block, not a status banner.
bestPractices: Pick `severity` by meaning. `danger` and `warning` render with `role="alert"`.
Use `label` for plain copy and the default slot when the copy needs inline links.
Use either the built-in action (`actionLabel` with `@action`) or the `action` slot, not both. The slot replaces the button.
Once `closable` or `life` dismisses the message, it stays hidden until it is remounted. Listen to `close` to keep your own state in sync.
Use `size="small"` inside dense surfaces such as cards and drawers.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token. Drives the banner height, inline padding, copy scale, and the trailing control sizes.

props.name: label
props.doc: Fallback message copy when the default slot is empty.

props.name: icon
props.doc: PrimeIcons class override for the leading icon.

props.name: actionLabel
props.doc: Label for the built-in secondary action button; hidden when empty.

props.name: closable
props.doc: When true, shows a close control that dismisses the message.

props.name: life
props.doc: Duration in milliseconds before auto-dismiss; `0` disables auto-dismiss.

events.name: action
events.notes: Emitted when the built-in action button is clicked.

events.name: close
events.notes: Emitted when the message is dismissed manually or after `life` expires.

slots.name: action
slots.notes: Custom action control; replaces the built-in Button when provided.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Alert copy. Inline content — plain text plus anchors, which the message region styles with the `.text-link` token — or flow content such as paragraphs and a list. The copy region is a flow container (a `div`, not a `p`), so block markup arriving from a server render stays inside it instead of being closed out beside the copy. Falls back to `label` when empty.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Alert from '@aziontech/webkit/alert'
</script>

<template>
  <Alert
    severity="info"
    label="Your workload finished deploying in 42 seconds."
    action-label="Label"
  />
</template>
